segments.orig:
[âat ýat pitô para-irithyeiti mâta
vâ para-irithyeiti cvat aêshãm upa-mãnayen
puthrô haca pitarem dukhdha haca mâtarem cvat dahmanãm
cvat tanu-perethanãm, âat mraot ahurô mazdå,
thrisatem dahmanãm xshvashtîm tanu-perethanãm.
segments.en:
If one's father or mother dies, how long shall they stay [in
mourning], the son for his father, the daughter for her mother? 
How long for the righeous? How long for the sinners?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They shall stay thirty days for the
righteous, sixty days for the sinners.'
segments.zh:
若人的父親或母親死亡，他們應當守喪多久？兒子為其父親守喪多久？女兒為其母親守喪多久？義人守喪多久？罪人守喪多久？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「義人應當守喪三十日，罪人應當守喪六十日。」

segments.orig:

kutha bun ýaozhdâta, âat mraot ahurô
mazdå, thrish frasnâiti tanunãm thrish frasnâiti
vastranãm thrish frasrûiti gâthanãm
imå nô âtrem ýazaêta baresma sterenaêta
aiwyô vanguhibyô zaothrå baraêta, ýaozhdâta
pascaêta bun nmâna vasô upâiti apãm
vasô upâiti urvaranãm vasô upâiti
ameshanãm speñtanãm spitama zarathushtra.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How shall I
cleanse the house? How shall it be clean again?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'You shall wash your bodies three
times, you shall wash your clothes three times you shall chant
the Gathas three times; you shall offer up a sacrifice to my
Fire, you shall bind the bundles of Baresma, you shall bring
libations to the good waters; then the house shall be clean, and
then the waters may enter, then the fire may enter, and then the
Amesha-Spentas may enter, O Spitama Zarathushtra!'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！我應當如何
淨潔此屋？它應當如何再次變得潔淨？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「你應當洗淨你的身體三次，
你應當洗淨你的衣服三次；你應當誦頌伽薩三次；你應當獻祭於我的
火焰，你應當束縛巴雷斯瑪的束捆，你應當帶來
〔缺〕
向良好的水進行奠酒；那麼這個房子將潔淨，並且
那麼水可以進入，那麼火可以進入，並且那麼
不朽聖者可以進入，哦斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！」

Ahura Mazda answered: 'You shall wash your bodies three
times, you shall wash your clothes three times, you shall chant
the Gathas three times; you shall offer up a sacrifice to my
Fire, you shall bind up the bundles of Baresma, you shall bring
libations to the good waters; then the house shall be clean, and
then the waters may enter, then the fire may euter, and then the
Amesha-Spentas may enter, O Spitama Zarathushtra!'
segments.zh:
若表親的孫子或表親的孫女
死亡，他們應當停留多長時間？義人停留多長時間？罪人停留多長時間？
停留多長時間？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『義人應當停留五天，
罪人停留十天。』
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！我應當如何
潔淨這座房屋？它如何才能再次變得潔淨？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『你們應當洗淨你們的身體三
次，你們應當洗淨你們的衣物三次，你們應當誦唱
伽薩三次；你們應當向我的
火祭祀，你們應當束縛巴雷斯瑪的束包，你們應當獻
祭水；那時這座房屋將變得潔淨，而
那麼水可以進入，那麼火可以進入，那麼
不朽聖者可以進入，啊，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！'

segments.orig:
âat ýat kãmcit vâ taoxmanãm
para- irithyeiti ýatha ainyô-varena ainyô-tkaêsha
cvat speñtahe mainyêush dâmanãm hãm-raêthwayeiti
cvat paiti-raêthwayeiti.
segments.en:
If a man dies, of whatever race he is, who does not belong
to the true faith, or the true law, what part of the creation of
the good spirit [Spenta Mainyu -JHP] does he directly defile? What part does he
indirectly defile?
segments.zh: 若一個人死亡，無論他來自何種民族，他不屬於真正的信仰或真正的律法，那麼他直接污穢了善靈〔斯彭塔‧曼紐〕造物中的哪一部分？他間接污穢了哪一部分？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýatha vazakhacit
... nôit avatha meretô!
ashem vohû...!!]
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'No more than a frog does whose venom
is dried up, and that has been dead more than a year. Whilst
alive, indeed, O Spitama Zarathushtra! such wicked, two-legged
ruffian as an ungodly Ashemaogha, directly defiles the creatures
of the Good Spirit [Spenta Mainyu -JHP], and indirectly defiles them.
'Whilst alive he smites the water; whilst alive he blows out
the fire; whilst alive he carries off the cow; whilst alive he
smites the faithful man with a deadly blow, that parts the soul
from the body; not so will he do when dead.
'Whilst alive, indeed, O Spitama Zarathushtra! such wicked,
two-legged ruffian as an ungodly Ashemaogha, robs the faithful
man of the full possession of his food, of his clothing, of his
wood, of his bed, of his vessels; not so will he do when dead.'
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『不超過一隻青蛙的毒液
已乾枯、且已死亡超過一年者的程度。活著時，
確實啊，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！這樣的邪惡、兩條腿的
惡棍，如同一個不敬神的阿舍馬歐加，直接玷污善靈
〔斯彭塔‧曼紐〕的造物，並間接玷污它們。
『活著時他擊打水；活著時他吹滅
火；活著時他奪走牛；活著時他
以致命一擊擊打信士，將靈魂
從身體分離；死後他將不會如此做。
『活著時，確實啊，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！這樣的邪惡、
兩條腿的惡棍，如同一個不敬神的阿舍馬歐加，搶奪信士
對他的食物、他的衣服、他的
木料、他的床、他的器皿的完全擁有；死後他將不會如此做。』
